thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated egress errors observed from az1a (ephemeral public IP churn). Metrics show 15% increase in GRPC retries for inference backend pools. Investigating.

oncall_jamie: seeing it too, spike started ~1709456700 per dashboard. Health checks flapping on a subset of ephemeral hosts.

sre_rita: symptoms? packet loss, conn resets, DNS?

oncall_jamie: mostly TCP RST/ETIMEDOUT, occasional DNS lookup failures for resolver endpoints. Attach: small ss/netstat sample.

eng-mike: past incidents where ephemeral ENI reassigns caused similar churn. Can we confirm persistent vs transient IP churn?

infra-lina: checking cloud console — control plane shows repeated EIP reassign events on the az1a provider side, likely due to host maintenance. Not all hosts impacted.

incident-bot: DETECTED: >10 host evictions in az1a in last 10m. Auto-redispatch engaged for streaming routes.

oncall_jamie: mitigation step 1: pause new ephemeral allocations in az1a for Reserved/ephemeral pools. Can infra block new ephemeral assigns?

infra-lina: issued policy patch to prevent ephemeral EIP rebinds for our fleet group. Rolling policy now (expected 90s).

eng-mike: routing: recommend shifting inference traffic off az1a for heavy write/streaming routes — enable cross-az fallback to az1b/eu for affected model variants. Will push routing tweak.

oncall_jamie: low-risk routing change ok. mike, do we have canary percentages?

eng-mike: start with 20% shift, watch tail latency and error rate. Policy: prefer same-region az1b then eu fallback.

customer-success-ana: PS Teams reporting increased 502s for customers in region. Working on short note to impacted customers, ETA once mitigation progress clear.

ops-rotation-bot: paging next oncall in 15m: @oncall_jamie -> @sre_rita handoff slot.

incident-bot: Current impact: ~8-12% of inference requests for az1a routed hosts returning transient gRPC failures (retryable). No data plane corruption detected.

oncall_jamie: action summary: 1) block new ephemeral EIP reassigns (infra done), 2) shift 20% of traffic off az1a (mike in progress), 3) enable aggressive client-side retries for affected route (temporary), 4) prepare customer comms (ana).

eng-mike: pushed routing change to canary pool (20%). Observing dropped requests decrease by ~60% in canary within 1min. Latency stable.

sre_rita: good. I'll keep an eye on KV cache invalidation effects — cross-az fallbacks can increase miss rates. Monitoring KVCACHE hit ratio and memory.

infra-lina: cloud provider reports completed maintenance on some hosts but EIP churn persists on ~3% of instances. We'll open ticket with provider.

customer-success-ana: draft comms: "We're investigating increased transient errors for inference in az1a. We're routing traffic to healthy zones and expect reduction in errors within the hour. We'll provide updates every 30m." Approve?

oncall_jamie: approve, send now with note: "workaround applied, no model integrity impact".

incident-bot: Incident severity: SEV3 -> raised to SEV2 due to multi-customer impact and elevated error rates. Paging frequency increased.

eng-mike: can confirm metrics trending down after canary. Recommend stepwise increase to 60% shift for safety window.

sre_rita: agree. When we hit 60% shift, we should watch KVCACHE regen and also ensure dedicated pools not overloaded. Alert thresholds set.

infra-lina: provider ticket created (INC-9982). Will update with ETA.

ops-rotation-bot: Handoff reminder: @sre_rita will take active ownership at 1709457600. @oncall_jamie keep them briefed on open mitigations.

oncall_jamie: quick status for handoff -> mitigations applied: ephemeral rebind block, routing 60% shift in process, client retry enforcement, provider ticket opened, customer comms sent. No active rollbacks required.

sre_rita: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate with infra for provider escalations. If errors trending <2% for 15m, we'll start rolling traffic back gradually.

customer-success-ana: will post update to affected customers in 30m with current status and next update time.

incident-bot: NOTE: create postmortem stub ticket INC-1709456789-az1a-ephemeral-ip-churn. Assign to SRE and Infra.

oncall_jamie: thanks team. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
